card.fact_statement: The preserved bones of the Ardetosaurus holotype include the left ilium.
card.source_span: The bones referable to MAB011899 comprise cervical vertebrae 13–14, dorsal vertebrae 1–10, several ribs, part of the sacrum, the left ilium, the pubes and ischia, the first five caudal vertebrae, two chevrons, the left coracoid, the partial left femur and fibula, the left tibia.

card.fact_statement: A paratype specimen of Sidersaura is cataloged as MMCh-PV 236.
card.source_span: Additional specimens were also assigned as paratypes. MMCh-PV 236, belonging to a mature individual, was found in close proximity
